package.shortDescription: Check-ins, reminders and minutes of your team's recurring meetings.
package.fullDescription: Ronde runs your team's recurring meetings: everyone prepares their check-in, the round table keeps time, the minutes write themselves. In Teams, Ronde reminds each person of their check-in by personal message, lets them fill it in right there, answers “ronde” with their next sessions and open actions, and posts the meetings' notifications in a channel.
package.commandRonde: Your next sessions and open actions

bot.welcome: Link it to your Ronde workspace: check-in reminders reach everyone here in Teams, and the meetings' notifications can be posted in this channel.
bot.welcomeWho: An owner or admin of the Ronde workspace does it, once.
bot.linked: This channel is now linked to the Ronde workspace “{workspace}”. In each meeting's notifications, choose what is posted here.
bot.unlinked: This channel is no longer linked to Ronde: check-in reminders go back to email.
bot.alreadyLinked: This team is linked to the Ronde workspace “{workspace}”.
bot.hello: Hi! I remind you of your check-ins, and you can fill them in right here. Write “ronde” to see your next sessions and open actions.
bot.help: Write “ronde” to see your next sessions and open actions. Your check-in reminders arrive here, with a button to fill them in.
bot.notFound: Ronde could not find this check-in for you. The email of your Microsoft account must be the one of your Ronde profile, and you must take part in the meeting.
bot.tooLong: This check-in is too long to edit in Teams. Please open it in Ronde.
bot.unknown: Ronde does not know you yet: the email of your Microsoft account must be the one of your profile in a Ronde workspace linked to this team.

link.title: Link Microsoft Teams
link.intro: The team “{team}” asks to be linked to a Ronde workspace: its check-in reminders go through Teams, and its channel can receive the meetings' notifications.
link.replaces: Already linked to “{team}”: this team takes its place.
link.none: You manage no workspace where Microsoft Teams can be linked. It comes with Ronde Team, for the owners and admins of a workspace.
link.expired: This link has expired or is not valid. In Teams, mention Ronde in the channel to get a new one.

settings.intro: Add Ronde to Microsoft Teams: everyone fills in their check-in without leaving Teams.
settings.locked: The Microsoft Teams app comes with Ronde {edition}.

uses.reminders: Check-in reminders by personal message, with a button that turns the message into the check-in's form.
uses.channel: The team's channel becomes a connector: in each meeting's notifications, choose what is posted there.
uses.command: Writing “ronde” to the app shows each person their next sessions and open actions.

settings.emailMatch: People are recognized by their email: their Microsoft account and their Ronde profile must share it.
settings.step1Hint: Your Teams administrator adds it once for the organization (Teams admin center › Teams apps › Manage apps › Upload new app). If your organization allows it, you can also upload it yourself (Apps › Manage your apps › Upload an app).
settings.step2: Add the app to the team whose channel will receive the notifications.
settings.step3: In that channel, Ronde posts a card: click “Link to Ronde” and pick this workspace.
settings.remindersHint: By personal message, in place of the email, to the people found in the team. The others still get the email.
settings.unlinkConfirm: Unlink Microsoft Teams? Reminders go back to email, and the notification rules posting to its channel are deleted. To remove the app itself, remove it from the team in Teams.
settings.notConfigured: To use Microsoft Teams, the administrator of this Ronde instance first registers its Teams app in Microsoft Azure.
